contract_highlights: message-scoped cancellation response gains an additive durable outcome discriminator with legacy boolean mapping
targetless ingress exposes pending, retryable, rejected, and pending-Stop truth without inventing a lane
a stalled ingress reaches a durable 60-second boundary and can be recovered only by an owner action on the same immutable message
one dashboard lane reservation per immutable message, with route_pending to dead_letter only on definite no-side-effect evidence
unknown route/effect outcomes become durable ambiguity rather than automatic duplicate delivery
bug report, dead-letter capture, and acknowledgement reply each carry their own durable receipt/idempotency boundary
dashboard QA receipt is a durable inbox with fenced claim/acknowledgement before any patrol-owned finding ID is shown
manual ambiguity assessment remains an immutable overlay, never a fabricated receiver receipt
reconciliation defaults to owner-controlled observe mode and needs a canary before active retries
reconciliation_pass_basis: one live workflow/implementation inventory plus three independent artifact reconciliations
